body:
Today I have retried using ART 1.26.5, spektrafilm (as updated until yesterday) and your tools **ART_spektrafilm.json** and **spektrafilm_mklut.py** (version lreleased 4 days ago).
Now it works!
But, before being successfull, I had to restart ART **twice** after removing all the caches.
So what I suspect is that your cache maintained spektrafilm working previously, while - as I reinstalled ART from scratch - I noticed the problem.

Thx!
Topoldo
